name: Machijuu de Rape!!
source:
Find a woman by walking around the town!
Attack her and force the act!
Put her in captivity after that!
Watch out for the police!

This is an erotic game to explore the town to find a girl to assault.

The operation of the main character is very easy.

6 girls are featured.
Each has different active hours.

If the police spots you out during the assault, they follow after you.
You may have to fight against them.

The goal is to collect all 6 girls in your home
